les: Van alles, in die regte hoeveelhede
kaps_punt: Gebalanseerde diëte: 'n dieet verwys na die keuse van voedsel wat ons eet elke dag; 'n gebalanseerde dieet bevat voldoende hoeveelhede van voedsel uit al vier voedselgroepe, asook water en vesel; sommige siektes kan toegeskryf word aan 'n swak dieet

items.bewering: Jou dieet is die kos en drank wat jy gewoonlik elke dag eet en drink. Almal het dus 'n dieet. Dieet beteken hier nie minder eet om gewig te verloor nie.
items.bron: CAPS NST Gr 4-6 wording as quoted in the lesson's own kaps_punt ('n dieet verwys na die keuse van voedsel wat ons eet elke dag); general dictionary sense of 'diet' as habitual food and drink versus the narrower weight-loss sense

items.bewering: 'n Gebalanseerde dieet het kos uit al vier voedselgroepe. ... Water en vesel is nie een van die vier groepe nie, maar jy het hulle nodig.
items.blok: Vier groepe, plus water en vesel
items.bron: CAPS Gr 6 NST (Life and Living: Nutrients in food) as summarised on the WCED ePortal lesson plan and DBE 2023/24 ATP Gr 6 NS&Tech (education.gov.za): 'a balanced diet contains sufficient quantities of food from all four food groups, as well as water and fibre'. Note: this is the CAPS teaching convention; the SA Food-Based Dietary Guidelines use a seven-group food guide instead, which is not a contradiction for this lesson.

items.bewering: Koolhidrate soos brood en rys gee energie, en vette en olies soos botter ook. Proteïene soos eiers en vis help jou liggaam groei en herstel. Vitamiene en minerale uit vars vrugte en groente help jou gesond bly.
items.blok: Vier groepe, plus water en vesel
items.bron: SA Food-Based Dietary Guidelines 2012 (FAO country page and FAO-hosted FBDG document): starchy foods as energy staples, fats as energy-dense, fish/chicken/meat/eggs as protein foods, vegetables and fruit for vitamins and minerals

items.bewering: Balans beteken genoeg van elke groep en van niks te veel nie. Vars vrugte en groente kan jy baie eet. Vette en olies, suiker en sout eet jy eerder min.
items.blok: Genoeg, en nie te veel nie
items.bron: SA Food-Based Dietary Guidelines 2012 (fao.org/nutrition/education/food-dietary-guidelines/regions/countries/south-africa): 'Eat plenty of vegetables and fruit every day'; 'Use fats sparingly'; 'Use sugar and foods and drinks high in sugar sparingly'; 'Use salt and food high in salt sparingly'

items.bewering: Hoeveel iemand nodig het, hang af van sy ouderdom en grootte en hoe aktief hy is. 'n Groeiende kind het kos nodig om sy liggaam mee te bou.
items.blok: Genoeg, en nie te veel nie
items.bron: NHLBI/NICHD (nih.gov) energy balance pages: energy needs depend on body functions and physical activity; WHO malnutrition Q&A on growth needs in children. Not an exhaustive list (sex also matters), but nothing false is stated.

items.bewering: Jou liggaam verloor elke dag water deur sweet, urine en jou asem. Jy kry dit terug uit drinkgoed en uit kos soos vrugte.
items.bron: Merck Manual Consumer Version, 'About Body Water'; LibreTexts Human Nutrition 9.3 Water Balance: losses via urine (~1.5 L), skin (~0.5 L), breath (~0.25 L), faeces (~0.1 L); intake from liquids (~1.5 L), food (~0.75 L) and metabolic water. The list is not exhaustive but is correct.

items.bewering: Drink eerder water as soet drank wanneer jy dors is.
items.bron: SA FBDG 2012: 'Drink lots of clean, safe water'; 'Use sugar and foods and drinks high in sugar sparingly'

items.bewering: Vesel kom uit kos van plante soos vrugte, groente, boontjies en bruinbrood. Die meeste vesel beweeg onverteer deur jou ingewande en help die kos aanbeweeg.
items.bron: FAO, 'Physiological effects of dietary fibre' (fao.org/4/w8079e/w8079e0l.htm); PMC9787832 (Dietary fiber intake and gut microbiota): fibre escapes small-intestinal digestion, is partly fermented in the colon, and insoluble fibre shortens transit time. 'Die meeste' correctly allows for the fermented part.

items.bewering: Bruinbrood het meer vesel as witbrood.
items.bron: NHS figure cited on the Wikipedia 'Brown bread' page and nutrition comparisons: ~2.5 g fibre per slice brown vs ~0.9 g white; SA brown bread is a blend of white and whole-wheat flour, i.e. contains bran

items.bewering: Sit elke kos by die groep van 'n belangrike voedingstof waarvoor dit 'n goeie bron is. Die eerste toets is of al vier groepe plus water en vesel daar is. Die tweede toets is of die hoeveelhede reg lyk.
items.blok: Hoe toets jy 'n dag se kos?
items.bron: Eggs are an excellent source of vitamin B12, riboflavin, vitamin D and selenium (Australian Eggs nutrient page; PMC6470839 'The Golden Egg'); dry beans are rich in folate, iron, magnesium, potassium and zinc (PubMed 24871476, Am J Clin Nutr 'Nutritional and health benefits of dried beans'; NDSU FN1643). So the rule as worded ('a group of AN important nutrient it is a good source of') does not give one placement per food: eggs and beans qualify for the vitamins-and-minerals group as well as proteins, and the rule then cannot produce the result the next block reports.
items.regstelling: The sorting rule must give each food one group: place each food under the nutrient it is MAINLY eaten for / its main nutrient, not under any important nutrient it is a good source of. The writer should choose the wording; the fault is that 'n belangrike voedingstof' lets a food belong to several groups.

items.bewering: Die pap, brood en rys is koolhidrate en eiers, vleis en boontjies is proteïene. Die botter is vet en die boontjies gee ook vesel. Die groep vitamiene en minerale ontbreek. Met 'n vrug en groente by is al vier groepe daar.
items.bron: Maize meal and wheat flour (hence mieliepap and bread) are fortified by law in South Africa since 7 October 2003 with vitamin A, thiamin, riboflavin, niacin, B6, folic acid, iron and zinc (Regulation R504 of 2003, FAOLEX saf90721; foodfacts.org.za 'Food Fortification'); eggs supply B12, riboflavin, vitamin D and selenium; beans supply folate, iron, magnesium and zinc (sources as in the item above). Thabo's day therefore contains a good deal of vitamins and minerals; what it lacks is fruit and vegetables. Under the lesson's own sorting rule (previous item) eggs and beans could fill that group, so 'die groep ontbreek' does not follow from the lesson's own method. The classification of pap, bread and rice as carbohydrate, eggs/meat/beans as protein, butter as fat and beans as a fibre source is correct.
items.regstelling: Say what is actually absent: Thabo's day has no fruit or vegetables, the lesson's named source for that group, so by the sorting the lesson uses the vitamins-and-minerals group has no food in it. Do not state or imply that his day gives him no vitamins or minerals — eggs, beans, meat and South Africa's fortified maize meal and bread all carry some. Keep 'Met 'n vrug en groente by is al vier groepe daar', which is correct.

items.bewering: 'n Swak dieet gee die liggaam oor 'n lang tyd te min of te veel van iets. Swak beteken hier nie arm nie. Sommige siektes kan deels uit 'n swak dieet ontstaan.
items.bron: WHO Malnutrition Q&A and fact sheet (who.int): malnutrition refers to deficiencies, excesses or imbalances in intake of energy and/or nutrients, covering undernutrition and overweight/obesity. 'Kan deels' is true of 'some diseases'; scurvy (later block) arises wholly from diet, which the later block states correctly, so no contradiction.

items.bewering: By tandbederf gebruik kieme in 'n sagte kleefstof op jou tande die suiker uit soet kos en drank. Hulle maak suur wat aan die tand se harde buitenste laag vreet tot daar 'n gaatjie is.
items.bron: WHO fact sheet 'Sugars and dental caries' (who.int): plaque converts free sugars into acids that destroy the tooth over time; Action on Sugar factsheet: bacteria in the sticky plaque film use sugar and release acid that dissolves enamel

items.bewering: Dit maak saak hoe dikwels jy iets soets eet en nie net hoeveel nie.
items.bron: Leeds Teaching Hospitals NHS Trust and Chelsea & Westminster NHS leaflets: decay strongly linked to frequency of sugary food and drink ('acid attacks' for up to an hour each time); PMC5727185 (in silico model): both total amount and frequency influence plaque cariogenicity. WHO emphasises amount — the lesson's 'nie net hoeveel nie' correctly keeps both.

items.bewering: By vetsug kry iemand lank meer energie uit enige kos as wat hy gebruik. Die liggaam stoor die ekstra as liggaamsvet. 'n Swak dieet kan bydra, maar beweging, slaap, familie en sommige medisyne speel ook 'n rol.
items.bron: NHLBI 'Overweight and Obesity — Causes' (nhlbi.nih.gov): energy imbalance, lack of sleep, genetics/family history and certain medicines (corticosteroids, antidepressants, seizure medicines); ASMBS 'Disease of Obesity': chronic energy imbalance

items.bewering: By diabetes beheer die liggaam die suiker in die bloed nie goed nie. Daar is meer as een soort. Die soort wat kinders gewoonlik kry, word nie deur kos of deur iets wat die kind gedoen het veroorsaak nie.
items.bron: HealthyChildren.org (American Academy of Pediatrics) 'Diabetes Mellitus Type 1' and Breakthrough T1D UK parents' guide: type 1 is the most common type in children, is autoimmune, and is not caused by diet or lifestyle; WHO diabetes fact sheet: raised blood glucose, several types. 'Gewoonlik' is correctly hedged, since WHO notes type 2 now occurs increasingly in children.

items.bewering: Die algemeenste soort is meer waarskynlik by mense wat baie jare te veel liggaamsvet het en min beweeg. 'n Swak dieet kan daartoe bydra, net soos familie en ouderdom.
items.bron: WHO diabetes fact sheet (who.int/news-room/fact-sheets/detail/diabetes): more than 95% of people with diabetes have type 2, largely the result of excess body weight and physical inactivity; NIDDK 'Risk Factors for Type 2 Diabetes': overweight, inactivity, family history, age

items.bewering: Die tekortsiekte skeurbuik kom as iemand lank te min vitamien C uit vars vrugte en groente kry. Sy tandvleis bloei en wonde word stadig gesond.
items.bron: Merck Manual Professional 'Vitamin C Deficiency'; Cleveland Clinic 'Scurvy': develops after at least a month to a few months of little or no vitamin C; bleeding, swollen gums and poor wound healing are classic signs

items.bewering: Die meeste vesel beweeg onverteer deur jou ingewande
items.bron: FAO 'Physiological effects of dietary fibre'; PMC9787832 — the quantifier 'die meeste' is correct because part of the fibre is fermented by colon bacteria. Recorded as a quantity claim alongside the block-level item.

items.bewering: dieet: Die kos en drank wat iemand gewoonlik elke dag eet en drink.
items.bron: CAPS wording in the lesson's kaps_punt; standard dictionary sense of 'diet' (habitual food and drink)

items.bewering: gebalanseerde dieet: Genoeg kos uit al vier voedselgroepe, plus water en vesel, sonder te veel van iets.
items.bron: CAPS Gr 6 NST as summarised on the WCED ePortal lesson plan and DBE ATP (sufficient food from all four groups plus water and fibre); SA FBDG on using fats, sugar and salt sparingly

items.bewering: voedingstof: 'n Stof wat 'n lewende ding nodig het om te groei en gesond te bly. Party voedingstowwe in kos gee ook energie.
items.bron: WHO Malnutrition Q&A (energy and nutrients as distinct intakes); SA FBDG: carbohydrates, fats and proteins supply energy, vitamins and minerals do not — so 'party' is correct

items.bewering: energie: Wat nodig is om iets te laat gebeur, beweeg of werk.
items.bron: Britannica Kids 'energy' and Let's Talk Science 'Introduction to Energy': energy is the ability to do work, make things happen and cause change

items.bewering: vesel: Die deel van kos uit plante wat die liggaam meestal nie verteer nie.
items.bron: FAO 'Physiological effects of dietary fibre'; PMC9787832: plant carbohydrate that escapes small-intestinal digestion and is only partly fermented in the colon

items.bewering: swak dieet: 'n Dieet wat oor 'n lang tyd te min of te veel van iets gee.
items.bron: WHO Malnutrition Q&A: deficiencies, excesses or imbalances in intake of energy and/or nutrients

items.bewering: kieme: Baie klein lewende dinge wat 'n mens siek kan maak.
items.bron: WHO 'Sugars and dental caries' and Action on Sugar: the agents of decay in this lesson are plaque bacteria, which are living organisms. The definition says germs CAN make a person ill, not that every germ does, so it does not overclaim. (Whether viruses are 'living' is a known boundary case; the lesson makes no claim about viruses.)

items.bewering: tandbederf: Skade wat suur van kieme aan 'n tand doen, tot daar 'n gaatjie is.
items.bron: WHO 'Sugars and dental caries': plaque acids destroy the tooth over time, leading to cavities

items.bewering: vetsug: Wanneer die liggaam oor 'n lang tyd baie ekstra liggaamsvet opgaar.
items.bron: WHO definition: obesity is abnormal or excessive fat accumulation that may impair health

items.bewering: diabetes: 'n Siekte waarby die liggaam die suiker in die bloed nie goed beheer nie.
items.bron: WHO diabetes fact sheet: a chronic disease in which the body does not produce or effectively use insulin, leading to raised blood glucose

items.bewering: tekortsiekte: 'n Siekte wat kom as die liggaam lank te min van een voedingstof kry.
items.bron: WHO Malnutrition Q&A (micronutrient deficiencies as a form of malnutrition); Merck Manual 'Vitamin C Deficiency' as the lesson's example

items.bewering: skeurbuik: 'n Tekortsiekte wat kom as iemand lank te min vitamien C kry.
items.bron: Merck Manual Professional 'Vitamin C Deficiency'; Cleveland Clinic 'Scurvy'

opsomming: Every health claim checks out, but the worked example is wrong: it says Thabo's day has no vitamins and minerals group, yet by the lesson's own sorting rule eggs and beans qualify for that group, and his eggs, beans, meat and South Africa's fortified pap and bread all supply vitamins and minerals — what is actually missing is fruit and vegetables, and the sorting rule must put each food in one group only.
